SHARED-F-2-S67.title: Two-Tier Consent Evaluation Engine
SHARED-F-2-S67.description: Implement core logic to evaluate and enforce Tier 1 (de-identified use) and Tier 2 (identifiable storage/use) consent decisions, including gating rules for storage, summarization, and downstream service access.

SHARED-F-2-S68.title: De-identification and Summarization Pipeline Enforcement
SHARED-F-2-S68.description: Integrate HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification and conversation summarization into the consent workflow, ensuring Tier 1 flows always store only de-identified summaries and Tier 2 allows identifiable data when permitted.

SHARED-F-2-S69.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
SHARED-F-2-S69.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier transitions, enforcement rules, de-identification guarantees, and cross-service behavior under different consent states.
